name: Truth Be Told
description: Descend into the world of true-crime podcasts with Poppy Parnell, who risks everything—including her life—to pursue truth and justice.

videos.title: Monster
videos.overview: While reviewing an old case, Poppy comes face-to-face with the man she put away.

videos.title: Black People in the Neighborhood
videos.overview: Markus drops a bombshell about a potential suspect's motive. Warren gets a visitor.

videos.title: Even Salt Looks Like Sugar
videos.overview: Identifying a new suspect has unintended consequences in Poppy's personal life.

videos.title: No Cross, No Crown
videos.overview: Poppy and Markus trace their prime suspect's movements on the night of the murder.

videos.title: Graveyard Love
videos.overview: Poppy continues building her new case, while Warren faces repercussions for his actions.

videos.title: Not Buried, Planted
videos.overview: A devastated Poppy tries to walk away from the case, but it won't let her go.

videos.title: Live Thru This
videos.overview: Poppy zeroes in on her new suspect, and Warren makes a fateful decision.

videos.title: All That Was Lost
videos.overview: Poppy enlists an unlikely ally in her hunt. The events of Halloween 1999 are revealed.

videos.title: Other People's Tears Are Only Water
videos.overview: Poppy attends an art exhibit for her friend, successful lifestyle guru Micah—but it ends in a shocking tragedy.

videos.title: Ghosts at the Feast
videos.overview: As she looks into the deaths, Poppy uncovers a massive secret. Shreve reveals a medical diagnosis to his family.

videos.title: If Wishes Were Horses
videos.overview: Poppy learns there's more than meets the eye with Micah's assistant, Ramon. Micah grows distrustful of those closest to her.

videos.title: In Another Life
videos.overview: The case takes a turn when another person close to Micah is found dead. Poppy and Ingram's marriage reaches a crossroads.

videos.title: If I Didn't Laugh, You'd Cry
videos.overview: Coping with personal struggles, Poppy begins to question herself. Holt's old friend finds him. Poppy and Aames identify a new murder suspect.

videos.title: All These Women
videos.overview: Poppy and Markus search for a mysterious associate of Holt's. Memories of Poppy's childhood with Miss Shirley invade her thoughts.

videos.title: Lanterman-Petris-Short
videos.overview: Rose tells Poppy about Micah's past. A protective Holt goes to extreme measures, with violent consequences.

videos.title: The Untold Story
videos.overview: Micah threatens to expose Poppy's dark secret. Markus makes a major decision.

videos.title: Brick by Brick It Also Falls
videos.overview: Poppy's pursuit of a suspect leads to a horrific confrontation. The truth about Poppy's childhood with Miss Shirley is revealed.

videos.title: Last Exit...Oakland
videos.overview: Grappling with the aftermath of the attack, Poppy interviews Micah on her podcast and gets to the bottom of the case.

videos.title: Unto the Sweet Bird's Throat
videos.overview: Poppy focuses her next podcast on the neglected issue of missing Black girls in Oakland as she tries to locate a friend’s teen daughter.

videos.title: Her, Armed With Sorrow Sore
videos.overview: Poppy takes the investigation into her own hands and grapples with whether she can trust Eva.

videos.title: Here She Shall See No Enemy
videos.overview: Markus tries getting to the bottom of a shocking discovery. Eva makes a startling confession to Poppy.

videos.title: Never Take Your Eyes Off Her
videos.overview: With the clock ticking, Poppy desperately looks for clues to Trini's whereabouts, leaning on Eva as a resource.

videos.title: Freedom Is Never Given; It Is Won
videos.overview: Poppy reveals her suspect to Markus—and risks her career with a bold tactic. Shreve's confrontation with a politician leads to an arrest.

videos.title: From My Hand the Poisoned Apple
videos.overview: Markus and Zarina wait for their nightmare to finally end. Poppy weighs having Eva on her podcast to help expose the suspect.

videos.title: The Luxury in Self-Reproach
videos.overview: Eva bares her soul to Poppy. Markus spirals out of control. Poppy and Aames uncover more evidence about the suspect in custody.

videos.title: Darkness Declares the Glory of Light
videos.overview: Poppy finds her relationship with Eva hanging in the balance. Markus and Poppy make a discovery that challenges their theory.

videos.title: Only Little Secrets
videos.overview: To find the girl from the blackmail tape, Poppy turns to Eva. Aames shares troubling information about the crime scene surveillance tape.

videos.title: A Kiss Not Mine Alone
videos.overview: Reeling in the aftermath of the attack, Poppy sets her sights on locating a suspect on the run. Markus seeks help from Shreve.
